objective: Ship one framework script that reports token and time cost per session, reviewer and PR. Commit a dated baseline of the 2026-10-10 numbers under docs/perf/.
why: ac1-1, ac1-2 and ac1-3 are not-verified. docs/perf/ on dev holds only hook-test-profile-2026-10.md. The debug scripts live in a session scratchpad, and the baseline numbers exist only in the 2026-10-10 debug synthesis. Each later slice must cite this script before and after its change (C3), so o1 comes first. The harness o4 slice takes its per-review baseline with this script. ac1-3 closes only when the later reconciliations cite this script, so it stays partly verified until o7.

include: Build the one token measurement script; the harness o4 slice uses it and writes no second script
Session view: context tokens per turn and context share by category and skill injections and compactions (ac1-1)
Reviewer view per reviewer and per review: first-turn context, total tokens, cache-read tokens apart, tool calls, CI-wait turns, cache rebuilds, cache TTL (ac1-2)
Forge view: Rex rounds per PR and hours from open to merge (ac1-2)
Report runs with a 1-hour cache TTL apart from 5-minute runs
A dated baseline file under docs/perf/ with aggregate numbers only, produced by this script, and the command form with a placeholder transcript path
Tests for the script on small fixture transcripts with no private content
A short usage section that tells each later slice how to record its before and after numbers (ac1-3)
Re-measure the 2026-10-10 session with this script beside the debug-synthesis numbers. A relative difference over 5% on any metric blocks the slice until the script or the synthesis is fixed.

Counting rules are tested on fixtures. A CI-wait turn is a reviewer turn whose only tool call polls CI status. The first single gh pr checks of a run does not count. A Rex round is one Rex verdict on one head commit. A refresh round is a Rex round on a head that differs from the approved head only by a base merge. A cache rebuild is a request whose cache-creation tokens exceed half its input tokens.
Refresh-round view: pure-refresh rounds out of refresh events per PR (for ac3-4)
Main-loop cache rebuilds during a CI wait (for ac4-4)
Resume rebuilds per 100 reviewer runs (for ac7-6)
The baseline file records the transcript SHA-256, the script commit and the Claude Code CLI version
The forge view reads only me2resh/apexyard, and the session view groups untracked or private skills as other
Run check-private-refs-runtime.sh on the baseline file and the fixtures before the PR
A records-PR classifier in the forge view: every file is under docs/orbit/, with or without one AgDR (for ac8-5)
exclude: Any change to hooks or skills or agent prompts or settings (o2 to o7)
A dashboard or a scheduled run
Reading transcripts of other users or uploading transcript content anywhere
Transcript text or local paths in any committed file
The Rex and Hakim baselines, evals and prompt trims (harness o4 slice)
